name: Show inherited and overridden fields in the details panel; revert a field to its base

comments.text: Markers done (set-here values marked * for a variant). Reverting a field to its base remains.

Done for the tab (D-191): marks show inherited and overridden values, a value can be set by key and JSON, and Revert to base restores a variant's value. Typed fields in the inspector's own widgets are not done.
